sender.en: The Prime Minister or a well-known person (fake video)

name.en: Deepfake video of the Prime Minister promoting a crypto investment

how.en: A video made with AI shows the Prime Minister or another public figure praising a crypto investment. People who sign up are called and pressed to pay, by transfer and even in cash, and then to pay more. One victim lost €52,000.

text.en: A video on social media shows a known figure endorsing an investment.
After you sign up, someone keeps asking you for more money.
Sponsored · Robert Abela: “I want every Maltese family to benefit from this new government-backed platform.” Start with €250 and see your first returns this week. Places are limited [link]

en: video of the PM promoting an investment
A politician or celebrity promoting an investment in an ad.
Promises of easy money from a “government” platform.
Being asked for cash or more payments after you start.
Ignore it and report the ad to the platform.
Don’t give your number or pay anything.
If you paid, call your bank and report it to the Police.

sources.title: Ukrainian woman accused of using deepfake PM video in cryptocurrency scam
